On King George Island, you will visit research stations and see where people live and work year-round. Take a Zodiac to Ardley Island and its penguin colony, see Collins Glacier, and spend the night at an ice camp on the glacier. The next day, the itinerary continues in the area around the elephant seal colony and China's Great Wall Station.

All activities in Antarctica are weather-dependent.

## Before the main itinerary

On arrival in Punta Arenas, a transfer from the airport to the hotel is provided.

The price includes 4 nights of accommodation: 3 in Punta Arenas and 1 on King George Island. Accommodation is in a single or double room at Hotel Cabo de Hornos or a hotel of the same category.

On arrival day, the guide meets the group at the hotel for a mandatory briefing on the Antarctica itinerary. The exact time and location are confirmed the day before. You will meet the other travellers, receive information about the trip and have a chance to ask questions.

You must arrive in Punta Arenas by 17:00 on the day before departure. Passengers who miss the briefing will be unable to board the flight.
